status: separate private-output foundation; native Windows/NTFS execution acceptance pending

target.parent: existing retained ReadDirectory; original read-profile ancestor, reparse and identity guards
target.directory_case_sensitivity: FileCaseSensitiveInformation class 71 must report flags zero for parent and owned directories

security.dacl: protected; one non-inheriting ACCESS_ALLOWED_ACE for the owner SID with FILE_ALL_ACCESS
security.scope: discretionary ACL boundary; not authentication, atomic snapshot or isolation from other processes with the same SID
security.checks: pre/post retained and named identity, attributes and owner/DACL checks on files and directories; observed failures poison, no atomic snapshot or closed inventory

creation.relative_to: held parent directory handle in OBJECT_ATTRIBUTES.RootDirectory
creation.existing_name: fail; no open, adoption or overwrite

rename.scope: same private root only; not a package publication/recovery protocol
rename.object_type: OutputFile only; directories are not renamed
rename.token: retained token binds the new name and parent after success

limits.scope: admission counters; not allocator/RSS, total CPU work or physical capacity guarantee
limits.objects_scope: includes private root; successful rename creates no new entry
limits.depth_scope: root depth zero; directories and files count one edge per child; file rename checks destination depth
limits.operations_scope: root creation starts at one; child creation, append, flush and rename charge before mutation; metadata-only verify calls are not charged
limits.total_scope: entire admitted append request charged before write; a partial I/O failure never refunds bytes
limits.path_scope: full admitted parent path plus separators/private root/relative descendants; checked before create or rename

validation.contract_tests: static source/contract/workflow consistency only; not execution acceptance
validation.native_runner: actual Windows x86_64 and fixed local NTFS temporary directory
validation.count_policy: exact listed inventory and successful runtime summary; zero or ignored tests fail
validation.wine: preliminary only; cannot close actual Windows/NTFS gate
validation.independent_acl_oracle: ordinary native PowerShell Get-Acl and SecurityIdentifier comparison for directory/file owner, protected DACL, one explicit FullControl ALLOW ACE, no inherited or inheriting ACE; child stdout/stderr suppressed; no SID/path output; source presence is not execution evidence
validation.impersonation_case: ordinary native ImpersonateSelf with RAII RevertToSelf; create rejects before mutation and verification permanently poisons existing root

not_claimed: complete package publication, sealing or receipts
Windows package recovery or durable directory entries

directory_target_probe.reason: compatible with the internal relative rename target open

sharing.directory_limit: write sharing admits directory write/reparse/metadata handles; pre/post identity, attributes and security checks detect observed changes and permanently poison; no atomic namespace against the same SID or administrators
sharing.file_limit: keeper excludes competing data-write/delete opens; WRITE_ATTRIBUTES, WRITE_DAC and WRITE_OWNER are not data-write sharing access; same-SID metadata/ACL mutation remains possible, checked before/after; compatible readers admitted

failure.admission: invalid args/token/name/limits and a known entry collision reject without poisoning
failure.observed: I/O or observed guard failure permanently poisons the owner
failure.rollback: no successful partial result or pathname cleanup/recovery guarantee

tokens.ownership: opaque root identifier plus object index; both validate before I/O
tokens.directory: Copy token; keeper and rename-target handles stay owned by PrivateRoot
tokens.file: Copy token; file handle stays owned by PrivateRoot; successful rename preserves token
tokens.parent_lifetime: PrivateRoot borrows ReadDirectory; parent lease cannot be dropped first

names.grammar: ASCII lowercase a-z, digits 0-9, dot, underscore, hyphen; one nonempty component
reject: DOS reserved stems con/prn/aux/nul/com1..9/lpt1..9 including extensions

flush.append: each admitted append flushes the file handle before success
flush.explicit: flush checks identity/security before and after and consumes one operation

diagnostics: static windows_output_* codes only; no path, SID or native OS error strings
